name: Equatorial Guinea
famous_for: Bioko Island volcanic peaks, black sand beaches, colonial Spanish architecture, and Monte Alén cloud forest.
tourists: Approx. 85,000 visitors; top destinations include Malabo cathedral, Arena Blanca butterfly beach, and Pico Basile peak.
must_know: It is the only sovereign country in Africa where Spanish is an official primary language.
fun_fact: The capital city, Malabo, is situated on the volcanic island of Bioko, rather than on the African mainland territory (Río Muni).
